intro.title: A pilot to structure application ecodesign within the Group
paragraphs: Orange Innovation wanted to choose a tool to support application ecodesign in order to contribute to decarbonisation.
The pilot was led by the « Responsible Digital » programme and an Orange Poland team from CEC Software Quality.
The experiment was run on two very different applications:
list: Orange TV, a video-on-demand and streaming application.

image.alt: Visual associated with the Greenspector POC led by Orange Innovation

results.title: An internal service to support Group entities
items: Experts are convinced by the approach and results achieved.
Orange Innovation is setting up an internal service to support Group entities on application ecodesign.
Greenspector analyses are used as concrete support to raise awareness among management and teams.

items.title: Collaborative work between centres of expertise
items.text: The project benefited from the contribution of Corporate Centres of Expertise « Software Ecodesign » and « Software Quality ».

items.title: A pilot on two very different applications
items.text: The pilot was run on two applications with very different technical and business contexts, to verify the relevance of the approach in several situations.

items.title: A team already experienced with test tools
items.text: The user team already had strong experience with test and performance tools, which facilitated adoption of the approach.

items.title: Concrete analyses for awareness-raising
items.text: Greenspector results serve as awareness-raising support for management and teams, especially in CX Reviews.

items.quote: « The Greenspector POC on the Orange TV application made it possible to establish a precise diagnosis of its operation and environmental impact. It creates a baseline, identifies improvement areas and guides future application updates. In short, this test is an essential milestone in the application optimisation approach. »
items.author: Benjamin Victor
items.role: Nearlive Marketing Manager & TV Platform, Orange TV France

items.quote: « A tool to raise awareness among management and teams with concrete evidence. Greenspector analyses are used in CX Reviews to illustrate concretely how applications align with Orange's environmental commitments. »
items.author: Céline Bouteyre
